spec.name: weblog
enabled
spec.description: When `true`, send HTTP POST requests to the configured URL (default: `false`).

spec.name: url
spec.description: The URL where HTTP POST requests are sent (default: `http://localhost`).

spec.name: basicToken
spec.description: Basic authentication credentials in the form `USER:PASSWORD`.
The `weblog` scope allows you to configure the `nf-weblog` plugin.
